access_scope: 2010–2023 race ID/date projection and train/validation entries only; static pedigree snapshot loaded globally. An earlier preserved preparation computed an immutable whole-database checksum without decoding or selecting test outcomes.

graph_descriptor_serialization.absent_train_categories: unknown token code 1; blanks use missing token code 0; counts <5 use rare token code 2
graph_descriptor_serialization.cluster: categorical decimal centroid index 0..63 or literal MISSING
graph_descriptor_serialization.depth: numeric integer 1..3 or blank (NaN after numeric parsing)

metrics.AP: tie-grouped entry average precision; duplicate sampled races count with multiplicity
metrics.Hit@3: sum labels of top three by score descending, horse number ascending, horse ID ascending, divided by 3; mean across all complete races
metrics.bootstrap: 2000 shared whole-race draws per surface using numpy default_rng(20261029); percentile 2.5,97.5 on mean paired seed differences
metrics.interpretation: Hit@3 difference and interval multiplied by 300 equals additional correct selections per 100 races; no profit/equivalence threshold
metrics.invalid: non-finite/out-of-range scores, invalid labels, duplicate keys or incomplete/<3 rosters stop

parent_feature_construction: P uses supervised same-surface prior-outcome summaries, strictly earlier dates, focal-horse exclusion and frozen end-2021 maps. categorical.external_target_encoding=false applies only to categorical-code preprocessing; P is outcome-derived.
